Stage.LogText: {=da_log_3_1}A messenger from {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} rides into your encampment, breathless and distraught. Catastrophe has struck the brotherhood of the anvil. Ride swiftly to the master's side.

{=da_log_3_2}The smith's brother and fellow master craftsman, {Kalan_Link}, rots in the foul dungeon of {DusmanKale_Link}. Without his ancient metallurgical secrets, the final folding of the steel is impossible. Infiltrate the dungeons, raise a siege, or ransom him before his spirit breaks.

{=da_log_3_2B}Horns blare along the battlements of {DusmanKale_Link}! Your escape attempt was discovered and garrison guards flood the corridors. You must fight your way out to deliver Kalan to safety!
{=da_log_3_3}Against all odds, you broke the chains of {Kalan_Link}! The twin masters of the anvil are reunited at last, ready to kindle the ritual fires for the ancestral masterpiece.

DialogNode.Text: {=da_haber_p_giris}Your messenger rode his horse near to death, master. What grief has fallen upon you?

{=da_haber_dlg_1}My brother, {Kalan_Link}... While traveling the passes with quenching fluxes, he was captured and thrown into the dungeon pit at {DusmanKale_Link}. His hands alone possess the secret temper to bind the blade's edge. Without him, our labor turns to dust. I beg of you, bring him back to the forge!
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_zanaat}Why is Master Kalan's craft so indispensable? What is the secret of these quenching salts, master?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_askeri}How formidable are the ramparts and dungeons of {DusmanKale_Link}? Does his rescue call for open warfare or silent shadows?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_fidye}Did the captors not demand a ransom, master? Can coin not unlock the dungeon gate without spilling blood?
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_npc_lore_zanaat}We are twin masters of the anvil; I shape the steel and rule the flames, while Kalan listens to the metal's song at the moment of quenching. With celestial fluxes he tempers the blade so it remains keen as a razor yet supple as a willow branch. Without him, this sword is stillborn!

{=da_u3_npc_lore_askeri}{DusmanKale_Link} is a black monolith perched atop sheer crags. Its garrison is numerous, and torches illuminate the battlements like noon. Yet in the dungeon corridors lie drainage sluices and blind spots during the watch relief. A master of shadows or a fearless rescuer can slip inside.

{=da_u3_npc_lore_fidye}They demand no ransom because they know not whom they hold! The castellan took him for a vagrant hedge-smith. If they discover his metallurgical secrets, they will bind him in chains to forge blades for enemy banners forever. Ransom is impossible; he must be extracted!
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_parola}When I reach the dungeon depths, how shall Master Kalan know I come as his savior and not an executioner? What must I say?
{=da_u3_p_sorgu_kusatma}If the castle guards sound the horn, I will drown their battlements in fire. What of Master Kalan's physical state?
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_npc_lore_parola}Whisper our ancient guild vow into his ear: 'The sacred fire turns to ash never, and true steel bends never.' When he hears those words, he will know the breath of the twin hearths.
{=da_u3_npc_lore_kusatma}He is weakened by days of moldy bread and well water, but his will is iron. When he hears the watchword, he will find the strength to run.
{=da_u3_p_yemin_sovalye}No craftsman of our covenant shall rot in an enemy pit. I swear upon my clan's honor to bring your brother Kalan back to this hearth unharmed.
{=da_u3_p_yemin_savasci}The walls of {DusmanKale_Link} cannot bar my fury. If need be, I shall leave not one stone upon another to bring Kalan home!
{=da_usta_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_u3_npc_ugurla}May the ancestral gods shroud your footsteps in mist, warrior. Show Kalan the seal of the forge; he will know you. Go, and wrench my brother from that subterranean darkness!
{=da_kalan_p_giris}Quiet, smith. Keep your voice low. I come under oath from your brother to cut your chains.
{=da_kalan_dlg_1}My brother sent you? Praise the ancestral heavens! But the portcullis is barred and watchmen patrol the courtyard every bell. How can we break through the garrison?
{=da_u3_k_p_kanit_ahit}Your brother bade me say: 'The sacred fire turns to ash never, and true steel bends never.' He awaits you at the anvil.
{=da_u3_k_p_kanit_savas}Look into my eyes, master; I am no phantom. I have come to tear these dungeon walls down upon their heads. Ready yourself!
{=da_usta_kalan_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_u3_k_npc_lore_guven}The covenant watchword... You are truly my brother's sworn companion! (Tears glisten on his soot-streaked cheeks) The gods be praised! The dungeon key rests on the head jailer's belt, and two torchbearers pace the courtyard.

{=da_u3_k_npc_lore_cesaret}Your fierce resolve speaks through your voice, warrior! I have loosened my manacles, yet days of starvation weigh upon me. Sentries bar our path; every step must be measured.
{=da_u3_k_p_sorgu_sizma}Where are the patrol blind spots between the guardroom and the outer passage? [Roguery]
{=da_u3_k_p_sorgu_kavga}Can you swing a guard's spear if we draw steel and carve our way to the gate, master?
{=da_usta_kalan_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_u3_k_npc_detay_sizma}The eastern archway has no torches for thirty paces. When the head jailer reaches for his wine jug, a shadow can lift the latch and slip through.
{=da_u3_k_npc_detay_kavga}My arms are cramped, but I can hurl a torch and crack skulls! Yet if the alarm horn sounds, the entire garrison will pour into the corridors.
{=da_kalan_p1}Follow in my footsteps and step only when the torches shift. I have mapped every guard rotation. [Roguery]
{=da_kalan_p2}There is no slipping past them quietly. Ready your fists or seize a torch; we carve our way to the gate!
{=da_usta_kalan_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_kalan_dlg_2}Like ghosts through the stone... Lead on, friend, before the relief watch arrives!
{=da_kalan_dlg_3}Alarms in the keep! The garrison has spotted us! Stand fast!
